item.ptxt: If communication between SUZUKI scan tool and ECM is not possible, perform the following checks:
Check communication condition between PC and VCI using SUZUKI scan tool function.
Check DLC power circuit and ground circuit.
Check CAN communication circuit and connectors between DLC and central gateway control module. (Refer to “Diagnosis flow: [a]” in “Troubleshooting” of “Troubleshooting for Lost Communication”.)
Check DLC cable. If necessary, check DLC cable by substituting a known-good DLC cable.
Check CAN communication system. (“Control Module Communication Bus Off” is detected in any control module.)
Check central gateway control module power supply circuit and ground circuit.
Check ECM power circuit and ground circuit.
With the generic scan tool, only data with asterisk (*) in the following table can be read.

When checking data with engine running at idle or racing, place gear shift lever in neutral position and apply parking brake fully. Also, if nothing or “no load” is indicated, turn off A/C, all electric loads, P/S and all the other switches.

topic.title: Engine Oil Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the oil temperature detected by oil pressure and temperature sensor.

topic.title: Fuel System A status (OL/OL-Drive/OL-Fault/CL/CL-Fault)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of A/F feedback control by ECM.

item.ptxt: Fuel injection time (volume) in the various engine states is determined beforehand. Therefore, information from A/F sensor is not reflected in fuel injection control.

Information from A/F sensor is reflected in fuel injection control. When ECM judges that actual air-fuel ratio is higher than stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, ECM controls to increase the volume of fuel. On the contrary, when the actual air fuel ratio is lower than stoichiometric air fuel ratio, ECM controls to decrease the volume of fuel.

topic.title: Short Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates short term fuel trim value (short term air/fuel mixture correction factor) and changes the value corresponding to driving conditions. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Long Term Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates a median value of short term trim learned in A/F feedback control (closed loop). This median value is used by ECM to correct fuel injection volume appropriately in open loop control avoiding interference caused by individual difference and aging. 0 (zero) indicates no correction, a value greater than 0 indicates enrichment correction, and a value less than 0 indicates enleanment correction.

topic.title: Total Fuel Trim (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the comprehensive fuel trim computed based on short term and long term fuel trim.

topic.title: Inj Pulse Width (msec)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the injector drive pulse width (time) during which the injector valve stays open as commanded by ECM. (For multipoint fuel injection, the injector drive time means that of the No.1 cylinder.)

topic.title: Ignition Advance (°CA)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the ignition timing of No.1 cylinder commanded by ECM. The actual ignition timing should be checked using a timing light.

topic.title: Fuel Rail Pressure (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates fuel rail pressure measured by fuel pressure sensor.

topic.title: Target Fuel Rail Pressure (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates target fuel rail pressure calculated by ECM.

topic.title: Desired Idle (r/min)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the target engine idle speed requested by ECM.

attention3.ptxt: When performing “Fixed Spark” in “Active Test”, actual engine idle speed may not follow the target engine idle speed.

topic.title: Calculated Load (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated engine load in percent. The load is calculated based on input signals to ECM from various engine sensors.

topic.title: Engine Speed (r/min)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the engine speed calculated by ECM based on input signal of CKP sensor.

topic.title: MAF (g/sec)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the total mass of air entering intake manifold measured by MAF sensor.

topic.title: Vehicle Speed (km/h, MPH)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the vehicle speed based on signals from wheel speed sensors sent from ESP® control module via CAN communication.

topic.title: ECT (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated ECT based on input voltage of ECT sensor.

topic.title: Intake Air Temperature 2 (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated IAT based on input voltage of boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2.

topic.title: Barometric Pres (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter represents barometric air pressure measurement and is used for altitude correction of the fuel injection rate.

topic.title: Evap Canist Prg Duty (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates valve ON (valve open) time rate within a certain set cycle of EVAP canister purge valve which controls the amount of EVAP purge.

topic.title: EGR Valve Opening (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates opening rate of EGR valve which controls the amount of EGR flow.

topic.title: Commanded Wastegate Position (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates valve ON (VSV open) time rate within a certain set cycle of WGV-VSV which controls the WGV opening.

topic.title: VVT Gap B1 IN (°CA)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates difference between target camshaft position (intake side) and actual camshaft position (intake side).

topic.title: VVT Gap B1 EX (°CA)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates difference between target camshaft position (exhaust side) and actual camshaft position (exhaust side).

topic.title: Commanded IAC Actuator Position (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates throttle valve opening of idle air control in % (100% indicates the maximum idle air flow).

topic.title: TP Sensor 1 Volt (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the input voltage of TP sensor (main) incorporated in throttle body.

topic.title: TP Sensor 2 Volt (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the input voltage of TP sensor (sub) incorporated in throttle body.

topic.title: APP Sensor 1 Volt (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the input voltage of APP sensor (main) incorporated in accelerator pedal.

topic.title: APP Sensor 2 Volt (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the input voltage of APP sensor (sub) incorporated in accelerator pedal.

topic.title: Accelerator Position (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the depressing amount of accelerator pedal in percentage calculated by ECM based on the input signals of APP sensor (main and sub).

topic.title: Throttle Position (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated throttle opening in percent based on input from throttle position sensor.

topic.title: Target Throttle Posi (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the target throttle position requested by ECM.

topic.title: MAP B (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated manifold pressure based on MAP sensor signal.

topic.title: O2S B1 S2 (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates output voltage of HO2S-2 installed on catalytic converter (post-TWC). It is used to detect catalyst deterioration.

topic.title: A/F B1 S1 Current (mA)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates output current of A/F sensor installed on catalytic converter with GPF.

topic.title: Battery Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery voltage inputted from main relay to ECM.

topic.title: Fuel Tank Level (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates approximate fuel level in the fuel tank. The fuel level data is provided in percentage from 0 to 100%.

topic.title: A/C Pressure (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates A/C refrigerant absolute pressure detected by A/C refrigerant pressure sensor.

topic.title: Radiator Fan (Off/Low/mid/High)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state that ECM operates radiator cooling fan relays.

topic.title: A/C Comp Relay (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of A/C compressor relay controlled by ECM.

topic.title: Fuel Pump (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of fuel pump relay controlled by ECM.

topic.title: Air Bypass Valve (Com) (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of air bypass valve controlled by ECM.

topic.title: Starter Switch (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates state of starting motor control relay output.

topic.title: A/C Switch (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of A/C operation controlled by ECM based on request from BCM.

topic.title: Blower Fan (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the signal state of the blower fan motor inputted into ECM.

topic.title: Brake Switch (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the brake switch.

topic.title: Electric Load 1 (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of electric load signal inputted into ECM.

topic.title: Clutch Switch (Clutched/Declutch)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates operating state of CPP No.2 switch.

topic.title: Cruise RES/ACC Switch (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of cruise “RES/+” switch.

topic.title: Cruise SET/COAST Switch (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of cruise “SET/–” switch.

topic.title: Cruise CANCEL Switch (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of cruise “CANCEL” switch.

topic.title: Cruise ON/OFF Switch (Released/Pushed)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of “CRUISE” (main) switch.

topic.title: Distance Setting Switch (Off/On) (Adaptive cruise control model)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of distance switch.

topic.title: Speed Limiter Switch (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of “LIMIT” switch.

topic.title: Speed Limiter (Inactive/Active)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the activation condition of the speed limiter system.

topic.title: Speed Limiter Main SW (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the speed limiter system.

topic.title: Fuel Cut (Stop/Cut)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of fuel injection.

topic.title: Closed Throttle Pos (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates monitored idle for engine control.

topic.title: O2S B1 S2 ACT (Active/Inactive)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the activation condition of HO2S-2.
ACTIVE: The sensor is activated.
INACTIVE: The sensor is being warmed up or not activated.

topic.title: A/F B1 S1 Act (Active/Inactive)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the activation condition of A/F sensor.
ACTIVE: The sensor is activated.
INACTIVE: The sensor is being warmed up or not activated.

topic.title: Piston Cooling Jet (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of piston cooling jet valve controlled by ECM.
On: Piston cooling jet valve is closed.
Off: Piston cooling jet valve is opened.

topic.title: Heater Shut Valve Actuator (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of Thermostat heater controlled by ECM.

topic.title: ENG A-STOP (Mon) (Engine Running/Engine Stop)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the engine auto stop.

topic.title: ENG A-STOP (Com) (Not Request/Request)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of the engine auto stop request.

topic.title: Target Valve Closing Position of High Pressure Fuel Pump (°CA)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates close timing of high pressure fuel pump delivery valve. Correlation between the close timing and amount of fuel supply into high-pressure fuel pipe is as follows.
0 degree: Amount of fuel supply is the minimum.
Larger degrees: Amount of fuel supply increases.

topic.title: Intake Air Temperature 1 (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated IAT based on input voltage of MAF sensor with IAT sensor-1.

topic.title: Boost Pressure (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the calculated boost pressure based on input voltage of boost pressure sensor.

topic.title: GPF Regeneration State (RgnMeasOff/ActvRunng/ActvWait/PassiveReturn/PsvRunng/PsvWait/Active/Passive)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of “GPF regeneration” in the normal driving condition.

topic.title: Soot Mass (g)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the amount of soot deposit in GPF calculated by ECM.

topic.title: GPF Differential Pressure Sensor Output Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates output voltage of GPF pressure sensor.

topic.title: Target Oil Pump Absolute Pressure (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates target oil pressure calculated by ECM.

topic.title: Oil Pump Absolute Pressure (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the oil pressure calculated by ECM based on input signal of oil pressure and temperature sensor.

topic.title: Commanded PWM Fan Control (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the target control duty ratio of radiator cooling fan motor calculated by ECM.

topic.title: ISG Rotation Speed (rpm)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG rotation speed.

topic.title: Battery Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery temperature based on battery temperature sensor.

topic.title: Outside Air Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery temperature based on outside air temperature sensor.

topic.title: Cell Average Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) temperature.

topic.title: DDC Internal Temperature (°C, °F)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates DC/DC converter temperature.

topic.title: ISG Actual Temperature Status (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG temperature states.

topic.title: Battery Pack Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) voltage.

topic.title: DDC LV Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates 12V side of DC/DC converter voltage.

topic.title: DDC HV Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates 48V side of DC/DC converter voltage.

topic.title: ISG Actual Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG voltage.

topic.title: Battery Current Sensor Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the battery voltage calculated based on battery current transmitted from battery current sensor.

topic.title: Current of Battery (A)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates battery current based on battery current sensor.

topic.title: Battery Pack Current (A)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) current.

topic.title: DDC LV Current (A)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates 12V side of DC/DC converter current.

topic.title: DDC HV Current (A)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates 48V side of DC/DC converter current.

topic.title: ISG Actual Current (A)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG current.

topic.title: ISG Actual Torque (Nm)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG torque.

topic.title: Brake Boost Vacuum (kPa)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates brake booster pressure transmitted from ESP® control module through CAN.

topic.title: BMS SOC (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) charge states.

topic.title: Brake Stroke (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates calculated brake pedal position in percent based on input from brake stroke sensor.

topic.title: Brake Stroke Sensor Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates brake pedal position information in voltage from brake stroke sensor.

topic.title: Master Cylinder Pressure (bar)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates brake master cylinder pressure detected by brake master cylinder pressure sensor in ESP® control module through CAN.

topic.title: Slope Value (%)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates slope angle (rate) calculated by ECM.

topic.title: ISG Starter Count (times)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG operation times. 5 times of engine restarting are counted as one.

topic.title: Neutral Switch Voltage (V)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates neutral switch based information in voltage from neutral switch sensor.

topic.title: ISG Belt Slip (times)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates ISG belt slipping times counted by ISG.

topic.title: Brake Stroke Sensor Not Calibrated (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the completed state of brake stroke sensor learning.

topic.title: S&S Control Mode (IG OFF Mode/Stop Mode/Normal mode/Auto Stopping Mode/Starting Mode)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates status of the “engine auto stop and auto restart control”.

topic.title: Starting Belt Slip (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter shows the slip judgment state of accessory drive belt at engine restart.

topic.title: Running Belt Slip (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter shows the slip judgment state of accessory drive belt at engine running.

topic.title: Neutral SW (ON/OFF)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates neutral switch states.

topic.title: Reverse Switch Status (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of gear position “Reverse” sent from ESP® control module through CAN.

topic.title: Half Clutch Switch (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of CPP No.2 switch.

topic.title: Clutch Step on Switch (Off/On)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of CPP No.1 switch.

topic.title: Engine Auto Stop Off Warning Request (No Indication/Continuos Indication/Flashing)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the lighting or flashing request of ENG A-STOP warning light.

topic.title: Prohibit Idle Stop Switch (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates pushed state of ENG A-STOP OFF switch.

topic.title: Hood Switch Status 1 (Closed/Opened)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of hood latch switch 1.

topic.title: Hood Switch Status 2 (Closed/Opened)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of hood latch switch 2.

topic.title: Driver Door Switch Status (Closed/Opened)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of driver door switch sent from BCM through CAN.

topic.title: Seatbelt Driver SW (Unfasten/Fasten)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of driver seat belt switch sent from BCM through CAN.

topic.title: Driving Mode Select Request (Normal mode/SPORT mode/SNOW mode/LOCK mode)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the request of driving mode select.

topic.title: A/C Compressor Engine Run Request (No action/Engine Run Requested)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine auto restart request from BCM during engine auto stop control.

topic.title: A/C Compressor Engine Run Order (No action/Engine Ordered)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine auto restart order from BCM during engine auto stop control.

topic.title: ABS/ESP® Status for A-STOP (Normal/Backup Disconnect/Inhibit/Failure)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of control on ESP® control module.

topic.title: IS Enable (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine auto stop permission judgment.

topic.title: Auto Stop System Enable (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of engine auto start permission judgment.

topic.title: 48V System Start Completed (False/True)
topic.ptxt: This parameter indicates the state of 48V-ISG system start.
